skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 60% ATK DMG to an entire row with 2 hit combo, with a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on targets that are crit for 2 turns (50% ATK as DoT).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 60% ATK DMG to an entire row with 2 hit combo, with a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on targets that are crit for 2 turns (80% ATK as DoT).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by 20%. When battle begins, grants 20% Bonus DMG RED. to allies in the same row and self for 3 turns.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by 20%. When battle begins, grants 30% Bonus DMG RED. to allies in the same row and self for 3 turns.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by 20%. When battle begins, grants 35% Bonus DMG RED. to allies in the same row and self for 3 turns.

effects.desc: Continuous fire damage over time to the target.
